sources.title: Brazil electoral court fines Meta, sees no deliberate election bias
Brazil electoral court fines Meta, sees no deliberate election bias

en.title: Brazil electoral court fines Meta sees no deliberate election bias
en.dek: The Brazil electoral court fined Meta but reported no deliberate election bias during the election period.
facts: The Brazil electoral court fined Meta on 11 November 2026.
The court reported no deliberate election bias according to The Hindu and CNA.
Meta informed the court last month it adopted measures for equal campaign treatment according to The Hindu and CNA.
body: The Brazil electoral court fined Meta on 11 November 2026, according to The Hindu and CNA.
The court stated it saw no deliberate election bias during the election period, according to The Hindu and CNA.
Meta informed the court last month that it adopted measures to ensure equal treatment of the two campaigns, according to The Hindu and CNA.
The Hindu reported the court fined Meta while noting the lack of deliberate election bias.
CNA reported the same finding regarding the fine and the absence of deliberate bias.
Meta stated to the court that it adopted measures for equal campaign treatment.
The court's decision was reported by both The Hindu and CNA.
en.context: The Brazil electoral court issued a fine to Meta. Meta informed the court last month about measures adopted for equal campaign treatment.
